suggestion.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Threads Don't Use Multi-Cores
suggestion.rationale: Python developers frequently hit performance bottlenecks when scaling CPU-bound tasks, making the GIL one of the most heavily searched concurrency concepts with exceptional loop-retention potential.
suggestion.hook_angle: Why does your 8-core CPU run your Python multi-threaded script on just ONE core? Let's expose the Global Interpreter Lock.
